map.化妆品质量三维评估：质量检查、持久性能、外观美观度综合评分: Three-dimensional cosmetic quality assessment: a combined score for quality inspection, durability and visual appeal
map.综合得分 = 合规安全 × 40% + 持久稳定 × 30% + 外观美观 ×: Composite score = compliance safety × 40% + durability stability × 30% + visual appeal × 30%. For each dimension the score rate = dimension score ÷ (5 × the sum of its item weights) × 100%; after conversion to a 100-point scale the dimensions are combined by weight. A composite of 90 or more is excellent, 80 to 89 good, 70 to 79 fair and below 70 poor. Items scoring 1 to 2 are put on the improvement list.
map.三维评估：质量检查（合规与安全）、持久性能（稳定性与持久度）、外观美观（感官与设: Three dimensions: quality inspection (compliance and safety), durability (stability and lasting performance), visual appearance (sensory and design)
map.综合得分 = 三维加权平均（质量40% + 持久30% + 美观30%）: Composite score = weighted average of the three dimensions (quality 40% + durability 30% + appearance 30%)
map.结果仅供参考，具体检测以实验室数据为准: Results are for reference only; actual testing should follow laboratory data
map.📚 深度解析：化妆品质量检查评估: 📚 In-depth analysis: cosmetic quality inspection assessment
map.从合规安全、持久稳定、外观美观三维度给成品打分。: Score the finished product across compliance safety, durability stability and visual appearance.
map.市场部评估竞品与本品质量差距，定升级方向。: Marketing uses it to measure the quality gap between competitors and own products and set the upgrade direction.
map.品控岗按固定权重输出综合评级用于出厂判定。: The quality control post outputs a composite rating with fixed weights for factory release decisions.
map.设合规安全 90 分、持久稳定 82 分、外观美观 78 分（满分各 100），: Set compliance safety 90, durability stability 82 and visual appearance 78 (100 each) with weights 40%/30%/30%. The composite = 90×0.4 + 82×0.3 + 78×0.3 = 84.0 points, which is good, though the appearance dimension could raise the packaging quality.
map.为什么合规安全权重最高？: Why does compliance safety carry the highest weight?
map.合规安全是上市前提，一票否决性质；持久与美观影响体验但不触及安全底线，故权重依次: Compliance and safety are a precondition for going to market and act as a pass-fail gate. Durability and appearance affect experience but do not touch the safety floor, so their weights step down.
map.三项都高才算好产品吗？: Do all three scores have to be high for a good product?
map.理想如此，但资源有限时可优先保合规与稳定，美观通过包材与质地微调提升，不必三项均: Ideally yes, but with limited resources prioritize compliance and stability; appearance can be improved through small adjustments to packaging and texture without investing evenly in all three.
